chunks: Say: 'If I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of an evil Day.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet fear if he disobeys his Lord?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the Prophet's (SAWW) profound humility and his fear of even minor deviations, serving as a model for the Imams and believers. It underscores the concept of 'Khawf' (fear of God) not as weakness, but as a spiritual strength that ensures steadfastness in obedience. The 'great punishment' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to the severity of the Hereafter, reinforcing the urgency of adhering to divine commandments.
